title: The Central Log Server must provide protected storage for cryptographic keys with organization-defined safeguards and/or hardware protected key store.
check_content:
Verify the Central Log Server is configured to provide protected storage for cryptographic keys with organization-defined safeguards and/or hardware protected key store.

If the Central Log Server is not configured to provide protected storage for cryptographic keys with organization-defined safeguards and/or hardware protected key store, this is a finding.
fixtext: Configure the Central Log Server to provide protected storage for cryptographic keys with organization-defined safeguards and/or hardware protected key store.
VulnDiscussion: A Trusted Platform Module (TPM) is an example of a hardware-protected data store that can be used to protect cryptographic keys.
